patch.value: Resolve human-agent decisions in a shared inbox

Collaborative web workflow over core Plan decisions with alternatives, evidence and audited SDK responses. Concurrent responses use revision checks; view-only users cannot apply; acknowledgments never count as code review or task completion. Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, remedies, docs, no-git and public tracker validation, browser screenshots.

value.text: Union regression evidence additionally verified with the pinned SDK: all non-closure fields equal the newer branch revision; all five imported closure fields equal main; the newer updated_at remains. The complete history chain verifies, and removing either newly added snapshot transition makes verification fail. Original lines remain unchanged. Direct node_modules/.bin/pm health --full --strict-exit passes all 10 checks. PM linked-test tracker copies omit durable merge-receipt files and therefore falsely report missing receipt references; removed the temporary health linkage rather than weakening health or discarding receipts. Existing linked npm and Bun full release checks remain the release evidence commands.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Merged-tree npm release gate passed through the pinned PM linked command (npm run release:check) with an isolated HOME and Git configuration: 787/787 suite tests, 2/2 capacity tests, 4/4 packed scenarios; zero failures, cancellations, skips or todo. All intended 49 server sources reconcile at unchanged coverage thresholds; production audit found zero vulnerabilities. Type, lint, duplication, docstring, committed build output, changelog/date and publish attestation checks passed. The shared host was heavily loaded, but this complete run did not time out. The Bun release gate is now running sequentially on the same resolved merge tree.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Whole-merge self-review for the same history-loss defect class passed: every original line from all 182 branch history streams (3025 original lines) and all 181 main history streams (3099 original lines) occurs byte-for-byte in the resolved tracker and retains its original per-stream ordering. Zero lost, rewritten or reordered original lines across either parent. The conflicting item retains its exact 16-record union plus the two explicit snapshot-transition audits and one normal trusted-receipt audit. Only the expected main tracker changes, changelog, merge receipt and this task evidence differ from the prior branch; application code and committed distribution remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Main integration complete on the resolved merge tree: both pinned PM-linked full release commands passed 1/1 each, npm run release:check and bun run release:check, with separate fresh HOME directories and isolated Git configuration. EACH gate passed 787/787 suite tests, 2/2 capacity tests and 4/4 packed scenarios, with zero failures, cancellations, skips or todo; 49 server sources met unchanged thresholds and production audits found zero vulnerabilities. Both completed under shared-host load without timeouts. Type, lint, duplication, docstring, rebuilt committed output, changelog/date and publish-attestation gates all passed. Application code, tests, lockfile and distribution remain identical to application head 09e64b3. All original history lines from both parents remain unchanged/in order; the conflicting item has the 16-original-record union plus three explicit merge audits and a fully authenticated, reconciled receipt. Direct strict health passed 10 checks with no blocking findings. Release the claim for orchestrator verification, retaining the feature in progress; the dependency item keeps its imported main-side historical closure. No review replies or resolution actions were performed.
